        (function () {

            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Meeting Agendas and Minutes</h1>

<h2>Council Meetings</h2>
<p>The Ordinary meetings of Council are set in accordance with Sections 257 of the <em>Local Government Regulation 2012</em> and are open for public attendance <em>(</em>some items may be closed to the public during the meeting to allow for discussion of confidential matters, this is known as 'Closed Session').</p>
<p>On some occasions matters may need to be considered before the next scheduled meeting of Ordinary Council.  In such cases a Special meeting will be called.</p>
<p>Rockhampton Regional Council Ordinary meetings will be held on the 2nd and 4th Tuesday of each month, commencing at 9:00am.</p>
<h2>Committee Meetings </h2>
<p>The Infrastructure Committee meeting commencing at 9:00am followed by Communities Committee meeting followed by Economic Development and Rockhampton Airport Committee meeting will be held on the 3rd Tuesday of each month.</p>
<p>Terms of Reference - <a title="Terms of Reference - Communities Committee" href="/files/assets/public/v/2/council-meetings/communities/terms-of-reference-communities-committee-13-august-2024.pdf" target="_blank" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Communities Committee<span class="file-info">(PDF, 89KB)</span></a></p>
<p>Terms of Reference - <a title="Terms of Reference - Infrastructure Committee" href="/files/assets/public/v/2/council-meetings/infrastructure/terms-of-reference-infrastructure-committee-13-august-2024.pdf" target="_blank" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Infrastructure Committee<span class="file-info">(PDF, 88KB)</span></a></p>
<p>Terms of Reference - <a href="/files/assets/public/v/2/council-meetings/council/2026-meetings/terms-of-reference-ed-and-airport-may-2026-1.pdf" target="_self" title="Terms of Reference - Economic Development and Rockhampton Airport Committee" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Economic Development and Rockhampton Airport Committee<span class="file-info">(PDF, 128KB)</span></a> </p>
<h2>Meeting Details</h2>
<p>Council and Committee meetings are livestreamed and may be <a href="https://www.youtube.com/user/RRCouncil/videos?view=2&flow=grid">viewed online</a><em style="font-size: 1em;">.</em></p>
<p>View 2026 Rockhampton Regional Council <a title="Meeting Schedule 2025 v2" href="/files/assets/public/v/23/council-meetings/schedule-of-meetings/meeting-schedule-2026-for-website-230926.pdf" target="_self" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>schedule of meetings<span class="file-info">(PDF, 220KB)</span></a>. </p>
<p>Meetings are generally held in the Council Chambers at City Hall, 232 Bolsover Street, Rockhampton, however occasionally meetings may be required to be held in other locations.</p>

<h4> </h4>
<h3>Previous Meeting Documents</h3>
<p>To see previous Council Meeting agenda and minute documents or defunct Committee Meeting agenda and minute documents <span style="font-size: 1em;">please</span> <a href="https://www.rockhamptonregion.qld.gov.au/AboutCouncil/Meetings-and-Minutes/Defunct-Committees" target="_blank" style="font-size: 1em;">click here</a> <span style="font-size: 1em;">and then select the relevant meeting. </span></p>
<h4>Council Meeting Procedures</h4>
<p>Rockhampton Regional Council adopted its Meeting Procedures at the Ordinary Council meeting on 11 June 2024.</p>
<p><a title="Council Meeting Procedures V3" href="https://www.rockhamptonregion.qld.gov.au/files/assets/public/legal-amp-governance/policies-amp-procedures/council-meeting-procedures-policy-v8-reviewed-17-april-2020.pdf" target="_none">Council Meeting Procedures(PDF, 234KB)</a> </p>
<h4>Petitions</h4>
<p>A petition may be tabled on behalf of constituents by either a Councillor or the Chief Executive Officer at the first available Ordinary meeting of Council. </p>
<p>For further information please refer to the Petition Submission Form and Petition Factsheet available here: <a title="Petition Template" href="https://www.rockhamptonregion.qld.gov.au/files/assets/public/legal-amp-governance/forms/gov01-petition-submission-form-v1.pdf" target="_blank">Petition Submission Form(PDF, 699KB)</a>.</p>
<h4>Deputations</h4>
<p>Deputations are the process for a member of the public or a group to be able to speak or deliver a presentation to either a Committee or Council Meeting.</p>
<p>Anyone is able to request a deputation to a meeting.  For more information and details on how to request a deputation refer to the <a title="Deputation Request Form" href="https://www.rockhamptonregion.qld.gov.au/files/assets/public/legal-amp-governance/forms/gov02-deputation-request-form-v1.pdf" target="_blank">Deputation Request Form and Factsheet(PDF, 695KB)</a> .</p>
<p>For a full list of the guidelines to apply to present a deputation at a meeting please refer to the <a title="Deputation Guidelines" href="https://www.rockhamptonregion.qld.gov.au/files/assets/public/council-meetings/deputation-guidelines.pdf" target="_blank">Deputation Guidelines(PDF, 70KB)</a> .</p>

		var isMatch = false;
		$message.find('.conditions a').each(function(){
			var $a = $(this);
			var mode = $a.text().split(' ')[0].toLowerCase();
			var value = $a.attr('href').replace(/^https?:\/\//g, '');

			switch(mode)
			{
				case 'startswith':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().startsWith(value.toLowerCase()))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'contains':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().indexOf(value.toLowerCase()) !== -1)
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'regex':
					var re = new RegExp(value);
					if(new RegExp(value).test(document.location.pathname))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				default:
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase() === value.toLowerCase())
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;
			}
		});
		if(isMatch)
		{
			var $main = $('#main-content');
			if($main.length === 0) return false;
			var $h1 = $main.find('h1').first();

			var description = $message.find('.description').html();
			var link = $message.find('.link').html();

			if(title !== '')
			{
				$('<h2>').addClass('side-box-title').text(title).appendTo($sideBox);
			}

			var descriptionBox = ''

			if(description.trim() !== '')
			{
				//If the description contains no html tags, wrap the text in p tags
				var noBrDesc = description.split('<br>').join('\r\n');
				if (!/<[^>]+>/.test(noBrDesc)) {
					description = '<p>' + noBrDesc.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n){2}((\r\n|\r|\n)+)?/g, '$2</p><p>') + '</p>';
					description = description.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n)/g, '<br>');
					description = description.replace('</p><p></p>', '</p>');

				$content.insertAfter($h1);
			}

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();

							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Meeting Agendas and Minutes</h1>

<h2>Council Meetings</h2>
<p>The Ordinary meetings of Council are set in accordance with Sections 257 of the <em>Local Government Regulation 2012</em> and are open for public attendance <em>(</em>some items may be closed to the public during the meeting to allow for discussion of confidential matters, this is known as 'Closed Session').</p>
<p>On some occasions matters may need to be considered before the next scheduled meeting of Ordinary Council.  In such cases a Special meeting will be called.</p>
<p>Rockhampton Regional Council Ordinary meetings will be held on the 2nd and 4th Tuesday of each month, commencing at 9:00am.</p>
<h2>Committee Meetings </h2>
<p>The Infrastructure Committee meeting commencing at 9:00am followed by Communities Committee meeting followed by Economic Development and Rockhampton Airport Committee meeting will be held on the 3rd Tuesday of each month.</p>
<p>Terms of Reference - <a title="Terms of Reference - Communities Committee" href="/files/assets/public/v/2/council-meetings/communities/terms-of-reference-communities-committee-13-august-2024.pdf" target="_blank" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Communities Committee<span class="file-info">(PDF, 89KB)</span></a></p>
<p>Terms of Reference - <a title="Terms of Reference - Infrastructure Committee" href="/files/assets/public/v/2/council-meetings/infrastructure/terms-of-reference-infrastructure-committee-13-august-2024.pdf" target="_blank" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Infrastructure Committee<span class="file-info">(PDF, 88KB)</span></a></p>
<p>Terms of Reference - <a href="/files/assets/public/v/2/council-meetings/council/2026-meetings/terms-of-reference-ed-and-airport-may-2026-1.pdf" target="_self" title="Terms of Reference - Economic Development and Rockhampton Airport Committee" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Economic Development and Rockhampton Airport Committee<span class="file-info">(PDF, 128KB)</span></a> </p>

<h4> </h4>
<h3>Previous Meeting Documents</h3>
<p>To see previous Council Meeting agenda and minute documents or defunct Committee Meeting agenda and minute documents <span style="font-size: 1em;">please</span> <a href="https://www.rockhamptonregion.qld.gov.au/AboutCouncil/Meetings-and-Minutes/Defunct-Committees" target="_blank" style="font-size: 1em;">click here</a> <span style="font-size: 1em;">and then select the relevant meeting. </span></p>
<h4>Council Meeting Procedures</h4>
<p>Rockhampton Regional Council adopted its Meeting Procedures at the Ordinary Council meeting on 11 June 2024.</p>
<p><a title="Council Meeting Procedures V3" href="https://www.rockhamptonregion.qld.gov.au/files/assets/public/legal-amp-governance/policies-amp-procedures/council-meeting-procedures-policy-v8-reviewed-17-april-2020.pdf" target="_none">Council Meeting Procedures(PDF, 234KB)</a> </p>
<h4>Petitions</h4>
<p>A petition may be tabled on behalf of constituents by either a Councillor or the Chief Executive Officer at the first available Ordinary meeting of Council. </p>
<p>For further information please refer to the Petition Submission Form and Petition Factsheet available here: <a title="Petition Template" href="https://www.rockhamptonregion.qld.gov.au/files/assets/public/legal-amp-governance/forms/gov01-petition-submission-form-v1.pdf" target="_blank">Petition Submission Form(PDF, 699KB)</a>.</p>
<h4>Deputations</h4>
<p>Deputations are the process for a member of the public or a group to be able to speak or deliver a presentation to either a Committee or Council Meeting.</p>
<p>Anyone is able to request a deputation to a meeting.  For more information and details on how to request a deputation refer to the <a title="Deputation Request Form" href="https://www.rockhamptonregion.qld.gov.au/files/assets/public/legal-amp-governance/forms/gov02-deputation-request-form-v1.pdf" target="_blank">Deputation Request Form and Factsheet(PDF, 695KB)</a> .</p>
<p>For a full list of the guidelines to apply to present a deputation at a meeting please refer to the <a title="Deputation Guidelines" href="https://www.rockhamptonregion.qld.gov.au/files/assets/public/council-meetings/deputation-guidelines.pdf" target="_blank">Deputation Guidelines(PDF, 70KB)</a> .</p>

<script id="COVID_TEMP-script">
	$(document.getElementById('COVID_TEMP-messages').innerHTML).find('.item').each(function(){
		var $message = $(this);
		var isMatch = false;
		$message.find('.conditions a').each(function(){
			var $a = $(this);
			var mode = $a.text().split(' ')[0].toLowerCase();
			var value = $a.attr('href').replace(/^https?:\/\//g, '');

			switch(mode)
			{
				case 'startswith':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().startsWith(value.toLowerCase()))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'contains':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().indexOf(value.toLowerCase()) !== -1)
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'regex':
					var re = new RegExp(value);
					if(new RegExp(value).test(document.location.pathname))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				default:
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase() === value.toLowerCase())
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;
			}
		});
		if(isMatch)
		{
			var $main = $('#main-content');
			if($main.length === 0) return false;
			var $h1 = $main.find('h1').first();

			var title = $message.find('.title').text().trim();
			var type = $message.find('.type').text().trim();
			var description = $message.find('.description').html();
			var link = $message.find('.link').html();

			var $content = $('<section>').addClass('obj-venue');//class is a hack to inherit styling
			var $sideBox = $('<div>').addClass('side-box message-box message-type-'+type).appendTo($content);

			if(title !== '')
			{
				$('<h2>').addClass('side-box-title').text(title).appendTo($sideBox);
			}

			var descriptionBox = ''

			if(description.trim() !== '')
			{
				//If the description contains no html tags, wrap the text in p tags
				var noBrDesc = description.split('<br>').join('\r\n');
				if (!/<[^>]+>/.test(noBrDesc)) {
					description = '<p>' + noBrDesc.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n){2}((\r\n|\r|\n)+)?/g, '$2</p><p>') + '</p>';
					description = description.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n)/g, '<br>');
					description = description.replace('</p><p></p>', '</p>');
				}
				descriptionBox += description;
			}

			var hasLink = false;
			if(link.trim() !== '')
			{
				hasLink = true;
				descriptionBox += link;
			}

			var $descriptionBox = null;
			if(descriptionBox.trim() !== '')
			{
				$descriptionBox = $(descriptionBox);
				$('<div>').addClass('side-box-content').html(descriptionBox).appendTo($sideBox);
			}

			if($h1.length === 1)
			{
				$content.insertAfter($h1);
			}
			else
			{
				$content.appendTo($main);
			}

			if(hasLink)
			{
				var color = ($content.find('p').first() || $content.find('.side-box-content').first()).css('color');
				$content.find('a').css('color', color);
			}

			 return false;
		}
	});

	})();

        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();

							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Meeting Agendas and Minutes</h1>

<h2>Council Meetings</h2>
<p>The Ordinary meetings of Council are set in accordance with Sections 257 of the <em>Local Government Regulation 2012</em> and are open for public attendance <em>(</em>some items may be closed to the public during the meeting to allow for discussion of confidential matters, this is known as 'Closed Session').</p>
<p>On some occasions matters may need to be considered before the next scheduled meeting of Ordinary Council.  In such cases a Special meeting will be called.</p>
<p>Rockhampton Regional Council Ordinary meetings will be held on the 2nd and 4th Tuesday of each month, commencing at 9:00am.</p>
<h2>Committee Meetings </h2>
<p>The Infrastructure Committee meeting commencing at 9:00am followed by Communities Committee meeting followed by Economic Development and Rockhampton Airport Committee meeting will be held on the 3rd Tuesday of each month.</p>
<p>Terms of Reference - <a title="Terms of Reference - Communities Committee" href="/files/assets/public/v/2/council-meetings/communities/terms-of-reference-communities-committee-13-august-2024.pdf" target="_blank" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Communities Committee<span class="file-info">(PDF, 89KB)</span></a></p>
<p>Terms of Reference - <a title="Terms of Reference - Infrastructure Committee" href="/files/assets/public/v/2/council-meetings/infrastructure/terms-of-reference-infrastructure-committee-13-august-2024.pdf" target="_blank" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Infrastructure Committee<span class="file-info">(PDF, 88KB)</span></a></p>
<p>Terms of Reference - <a href="/files/assets/public/v/2/council-meetings/council/2026-meetings/terms-of-reference-ed-and-airport-may-2026-1.pdf" target="_self" title="Terms of Reference - Economic Development and Rockhampton Airport Committee" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Economic Development and Rockhampton Airport Committee<span class="file-info">(PDF, 128KB)</span></a> </p>
<h2>Meeting Details</h2>
<p>Council and Committee meetings are livestreamed and may be <a href="https://www.youtube.com/user/RRCouncil/videos?view=2&flow=grid">viewed online</a><em style="font-size: 1em;">.</em></p>
<p>View 2026 Rockhampton Regional Council <a title="Meeting Schedule 2025 v2" href="/files/assets/public/v/23/council-meetings/schedule-of-meetings/meeting-schedule-2026-for-website-230926.pdf" target="_self" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>schedule of meetings<span class="file-info">(PDF, 220KB)</span></a>. </p>
<p>Meetings are generally held in the Council Chambers at City Hall, 232 Bolsover Street, Rockhampton, however occasionally meetings may be required to be held in other locations.</p>

<h4> </h4>
<h3>Previous Meeting Documents</h3>
<p>To see previous Council Meeting agenda and minute documents or defunct Committee Meeting agenda and minute documents <span style="font-size: 1em;">please</span> <a href="https://www.rockhamptonregion.qld.gov.au/AboutCouncil/Meetings-and-Minutes/Defunct-Committees" target="_blank" style="font-size: 1em;">click here</a> <span style="font-size: 1em;">and then select the relevant meeting. </span></p>
<h4>Council Meeting Procedures</h4>
<p>Rockhampton Regional Council adopted its Meeting Procedures at the Ordinary Council meeting on 11 June 2024.</p>
<p><a title="Council Meeting Procedures V3" href="https://www.rockhamptonregion.qld.gov.au/files/assets/public/legal-amp-governance/policies-amp-procedures/council-meeting-procedures-policy-v8-reviewed-17-april-2020.pdf" target="_none">Council Meeting Procedures(PDF, 234KB)</a> </p>
<h4>Petitions</h4>
<p>A petition may be tabled on behalf of constituents by either a Councillor or the Chief Executive Officer at the first available Ordinary meeting of Council. </p>
<p>For further information please refer to the Petition Submission Form and Petition Factsheet available here: <a title="Petition Template" href="https://www.rockhamptonregion.qld.gov.au/files/assets/public/legal-amp-governance/forms/gov01-petition-submission-form-v1.pdf" target="_blank">Petition Submission Form(PDF, 699KB)</a>.</p>
<h4>Deputations</h4>
<p>Deputations are the process for a member of the public or a group to be able to speak or deliver a presentation to either a Committee or Council Meeting.</p>
<p>Anyone is able to request a deputation to a meeting.  For more information and details on how to request a deputation refer to the <a title="Deputation Request Form" href="https://www.rockhamptonregion.qld.gov.au/files/assets/public/legal-amp-governance/forms/gov02-deputation-request-form-v1.pdf" target="_blank">Deputation Request Form and Factsheet(PDF, 695KB)</a> .</p>
<p>For a full list of the guidelines to apply to present a deputation at a meeting please refer to the <a title="Deputation Guidelines" href="https://www.rockhamptonregion.qld.gov.au/files/assets/public/council-meetings/deputation-guidelines.pdf" target="_blank">Deputation Guidelines(PDF, 70KB)</a> .</p>

	$(document.getElementById('COVID_TEMP-messages').innerHTML).find('.item').each(function(){
		var $message = $(this);
		var isMatch = false;
		$message.find('.conditions a').each(function(){
			var $a = $(this);
			var mode = $a.text().split(' ')[0].toLowerCase();
			var value = $a.attr('href').replace(/^https?:\/\//g, '');

			switch(mode)
			{
				case 'startswith':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().startsWith(value.toLowerCase()))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'contains':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().indexOf(value.toLowerCase()) !== -1)
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'regex':
					var re = new RegExp(value);
					if(new RegExp(value).test(document.location.pathname))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				default:
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase() === value.toLowerCase())
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;
			}
		});
		if(isMatch)
		{
			var $main = $('#main-content');
			if($main.length === 0) return false;
			var $h1 = $main.find('h1').first();

			var title = $message.find('.title').text().trim();
			var type = $message.find('.type').text().trim();
			var description = $message.find('.description').html();
			var link = $message.find('.link').html();

			var $content = $('<section>').addClass('obj-venue');//class is a hack to inherit styling
			var $sideBox = $('<div>').addClass('side-box message-box message-type-'+type).appendTo($content);

			if(title !== '')
			{
				$('<h2>').addClass('side-box-title').text(title).appendTo($sideBox);
			}

			var descriptionBox = ''

			if(description.trim() !== '')
			{
				//If the description contains no html tags, wrap the text in p tags
				var noBrDesc = description.split('<br>').join('\r\n');
				if (!/<[^>]+>/.test(noBrDesc)) {
					description = '<p>' + noBrDesc.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n){2}((\r\n|\r|\n)+)?/g, '$2</p><p>') + '</p>';
					description = description.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n)/g, '<br>');
					description = description.replace('</p><p></p>', '</p>');
				}
				descriptionBox += description;
			}

			var hasLink = false;
			if(link.trim() !== '')
			{
				hasLink = true;
				descriptionBox += link;
			}

			var $descriptionBox = null;
			if(descriptionBox.trim() !== '')
			{
				$descriptionBox = $(descriptionBox);
				$('<div>').addClass('side-box-content').html(descriptionBox).appendTo($sideBox);
			}

			if($h1.length === 1)
			{
				$content.insertAfter($h1);
			}
			else
			{
				$content.appendTo($main);
			}

			if(hasLink)
			{
				var color = ($content.find('p').first() || $content.find('.side-box-content').first()).css('color');
				$content.find('a').css('color', color);
			}

			 return false;
		}
	});

        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();

							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Meeting Agendas and Minutes</h1>

<h2>Council Meetings</h2>
<p>The Ordinary meetings of Council are set in accordance with Sections 257 of the <em>Local Government Regulation 2012</em> and are open for public attendance <em>(</em>some items may be closed to the public during the meeting to allow for discussion of confidential matters, this is known as 'Closed Session').</p>
<p>On some occasions matters may need to be considered before the next scheduled meeting of Ordinary Council.  In such cases a Special meeting will be called.</p>
<p>Rockhampton Regional Council Ordinary meetings will be held on the 2nd and 4th Tuesday of each month, commencing at 9:00am.</p>
<h2>Committee Meetings </h2>
<p>The Infrastructure Committee meeting commencing at 9:00am followed by Communities Committee meeting followed by Economic Development and Rockhampton Airport Committee meeting will be held on the 3rd Tuesday of each month.</p>
<p>Terms of Reference - <a title="Terms of Reference - Communities Committee" href="/files/assets/public/v/2/council-meetings/communities/terms-of-reference-communities-committee-13-august-2024.pdf" target="_blank" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Communities Committee<span class="file-info">(PDF, 89KB)</span></a></p>
<p>Terms of Reference - <a title="Terms of Reference - Infrastructure Committee" href="/files/assets/public/v/2/council-meetings/infrastructure/terms-of-reference-infrastructure-committee-13-august-2024.pdf" target="_blank" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Infrastructure Committee<span class="file-info">(PDF, 88KB)</span></a></p>
<p>Terms of Reference - <a href="/files/assets/public/v/2/council-meetings/council/2026-meetings/terms-of-reference-ed-and-airport-may-2026-1.pdf" target="_self" title="Terms of Reference - Economic Development and Rockhampton Airport Committee" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Economic Development and Rockhampton Airport Committee<span class="file-info">(PDF, 128KB)</span></a> </p>
<h2>Meeting Details</h2>
<p>Council and Committee meetings are livestreamed and may be <a href="https://www.youtube.com/user/RRCouncil/videos?view=2&flow=grid">viewed online</a><em style="font-size: 1em;">.</em></p>
<p>View 2026 Rockhampton Regional Council <a title="Meeting Schedule 2025 v2" href="/files/assets/public/v/23/council-meetings/schedule-of-meetings/meeting-schedule-2026-for-website-230926.pdf" target="_self" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>schedule of meetings<span class="file-info">(PDF, 220KB)</span></a>. </p>
<p>Meetings are generally held in the Council Chambers at City Hall, 232 Bolsover Street, Rockhampton, however occasionally meetings may be required to be held in other locations.</p>

<h4> </h4>
<h3>Previous Meeting Documents</h3>
<p>To see previous Council Meeting agenda and minute documents or defunct Committee Meeting agenda and minute documents <span style="font-size: 1em;">please</span> <a href="https://www.rockhamptonregion.qld.gov.au/AboutCouncil/Meetings-and-Minutes/Defunct-Committees" target="_blank" style="font-size: 1em;">click here</a> <span style="font-size: 1em;">and then select the relevant meeting. </span></p>
<h4>Council Meeting Procedures</h4>
<p>Rockhampton Regional Council adopted its Meeting Procedures at the Ordinary Council meeting on 11 June 2024.</p>
<p><a title="Council Meeting Procedures V3" href="https://www.rockhamptonregion.qld.gov.au/files/assets/public/legal-amp-governance/policies-amp-procedures/council-meeting-procedures-policy-v8-reviewed-17-april-2020.pdf" target="_none">Council Meeting Procedures(PDF, 234KB)</a> </p>
<h4>Petitions</h4>
<p>A petition may be tabled on behalf of constituents by either a Councillor or the Chief Executive Officer at the first available Ordinary meeting of Council. </p>
<p>For further information please refer to the Petition Submission Form and Petition Factsheet available here: <a title="Petition Template" href="https://www.rockhamptonregion.qld.gov.au/files/assets/public/legal-amp-governance/forms/gov01-petition-submission-form-v1.pdf" target="_blank">Petition Submission Form(PDF, 699KB)</a>.</p>
<h4>Deputations</h4>
<p>Deputations are the process for a member of the public or a group to be able to speak or deliver a presentation to either a Committee or Council Meeting.</p>
<p>Anyone is able to request a deputation to a meeting.  For more information and details on how to request a deputation refer to the <a title="Deputation Request Form" href="https://www.rockhamptonregion.qld.gov.au/files/assets/public/legal-amp-governance/forms/gov02-deputation-request-form-v1.pdf" target="_blank">Deputation Request Form and Factsheet(PDF, 695KB)</a> .</p>
<p>For a full list of the guidelines to apply to present a deputation at a meeting please refer to the <a title="Deputation Guidelines" href="https://www.rockhamptonregion.qld.gov.au/files/assets/public/council-meetings/deputation-guidelines.pdf" target="_blank">Deputation Guidelines(PDF, 70KB)</a> .</p>

<script id="COVID_TEMP-script">
	$(document.getElementById('COVID_TEMP-messages').innerHTML).find('.item').each(function(){
		var $message = $(this);
		var isMatch = false;
		$message.find('.conditions a').each(function(){
			var $a = $(this);
			var mode = $a.text().split(' ')[0].toLowerCase();
			var value = $a.attr('href').replace(/^https?:\/\//g, '');

			switch(mode)
			{
				case 'startswith':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().startsWith(value.toLowerCase()))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'contains':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().indexOf(value.toLowerCase()) !== -1)
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'regex':
					var re = new RegExp(value);
					if(new RegExp(value).test(document.location.pathname))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				default:
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase() === value.toLowerCase())
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;
			}
		});
		if(isMatch)
		{
			var $main = $('#main-content');
			if($main.length === 0) return false;
			var $h1 = $main.find('h1').first();

			var title = $message.find('.title').text().trim();
			var type = $message.find('.type').text().trim();
			var description = $message.find('.description').html();
			var link = $message.find('.link').html();

			var $content = $('<section>').addClass('obj-venue');//class is a hack to inherit styling
			var $sideBox = $('<div>').addClass('side-box message-box message-type-'+type).appendTo($content);

			if(title !== '')
			{
				$('<h2>').addClass('side-box-title').text(title).appendTo($sideBox);
			}

			var descriptionBox = ''

			if(description.trim() !== '')
			{
				//If the description contains no html tags, wrap the text in p tags
				var noBrDesc = description.split('<br>').join('\r\n');
				if (!/<[^>]+>/.test(noBrDesc)) {
					description = '<p>' + noBrDesc.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n){2}((\r\n|\r|\n)+)?/g, '$2</p><p>') + '</p>';
					description = description.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n)/g, '<br>');
					description = description.replace('</p><p></p>', '</p>');
				}
				descriptionBox += description;
			}

			var hasLink = false;
			if(link.trim() !== '')
			{
				hasLink = true;
				descriptionBox += link;
			}

			var $descriptionBox = null;
			if(descriptionBox.trim() !== '')
			{
				$descriptionBox = $(descriptionBox);
				$('<div>').addClass('side-box-content').html(descriptionBox).appendTo($sideBox);
			}

			if($h1.length === 1)
			{
				$content.insertAfter($h1);
			}
			else
			{
				$content.appendTo($main);
			}

			if(hasLink)
			{
				var color = ($content.find('p').first() || $content.find('.side-box-content').first()).css('color');
				$content.find('a').css('color', color);
			}

			 return false;
		}
	});

							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Meeting Agendas and Minutes</h1>

<h2>Council Meetings</h2>
<p>The Ordinary meetings of Council are set in accordance with Sections 257 of the <em>Local Government Regulation 2012</em> and are open for public attendance <em>(</em>some items may be closed to the public during the meeting to allow for discussion of confidential matters, this is known as 'Closed Session').</p>
<p>On some occasions matters may need to be considered before the next scheduled meeting of Ordinary Council.  In such cases a Special meeting will be called.</p>
<p>Rockhampton Regional Council Ordinary meetings will be held on the 2nd and 4th Tuesday of each month, commencing at 9:00am.</p>
<h2>Committee Meetings </h2>
<p>The Infrastructure Committee meeting commencing at 9:00am followed by Communities Committee meeting followed by Economic Development and Rockhampton Airport Committee meeting will be held on the 3rd Tuesday of each month.</p>
<p>Terms of Reference - <a title="Terms of Reference - Communities Committee" href="/files/assets/public/v/2/council-meetings/communities/terms-of-reference-communities-committee-13-august-2024.pdf" target="_blank" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Communities Committee<span class="file-info">(PDF, 89KB)</span></a></p>
<p>Terms of Reference - <a title="Terms of Reference - Infrastructure Committee" href="/files/assets/public/v/2/council-meetings/infrastructure/terms-of-reference-infrastructure-committee-13-august-2024.pdf" target="_blank" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Infrastructure Committee<span class="file-info">(PDF, 88KB)</span></a></p>
<p>Terms of Reference - <a href="/files/assets/public/v/2/council-meetings/council/2026-meetings/terms-of-reference-ed-and-airport-may-2026-1.pdf" target="_self" title="Terms of Reference - Economic Development and Rockhampton Airport Committee" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Economic Development and Rockhampton Airport Committee<span class="file-info">(PDF, 128KB)</span></a> </p>
<h2>Meeting Details</h2>
<p>Council and Committee meetings are livestreamed and may be <a href="https://www.youtube.com/user/RRCouncil/videos?view=2&flow=grid">viewed online</a><em style="font-size: 1em;">.</em></p>
<p>View 2026 Rockhampton Regional Council <a title="Meeting Schedule 2025 v2" href="/files/assets/public/v/23/council-meetings/schedule-of-meetings/meeting-schedule-2026-for-website-230926.pdf" target="_self" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>schedule of meetings<span class="file-info">(PDF, 220KB)</span></a>. </p>
<p>Meetings are generally held in the Council Chambers at City Hall, 232 Bolsover Street, Rockhampton, however occasionally meetings may be required to be held in other locations.</p>

<h4> </h4>
<h3>Previous Meeting Documents</h3>
<p>To see previous Council Meeting agenda and minute documents or defunct Committee Meeting agenda and minute documents <span style="font-size: 1em;">please</span> <a href="https://www.rockhamptonregion.qld.gov.au/AboutCouncil/Meetings-and-Minutes/Defunct-Committees" target="_blank" style="font-size: 1em;">click here</a> <span style="font-size: 1em;">and then select the relevant meeting. </span></p>
<h4>Council Meeting Procedures</h4>
<p>Rockhampton Regional Council adopted its Meeting Procedures at the Ordinary Council meeting on 11 June 2024.</p>
<p><a title="Council Meeting Procedures V3" href="https://www.rockhamptonregion.qld.gov.au/files/assets/public/legal-amp-governance/policies-amp-procedures/council-meeting-procedures-policy-v8-reviewed-17-april-2020.pdf" target="_none">Council Meeting Procedures(PDF, 234KB)</a> </p>
<h4>Petitions</h4>
<p>A petition may be tabled on behalf of constituents by either a Councillor or the Chief Executive Officer at the first available Ordinary meeting of Council. </p>
<p>For further information please refer to the Petition Submission Form and Petition Factsheet available here: <a title="Petition Template" href="https://www.rockhamptonregion.qld.gov.au/files/assets/public/legal-amp-governance/forms/gov01-petition-submission-form-v1.pdf" target="_blank">Petition Submission Form(PDF, 699KB)</a>.</p>
<h4>Deputations</h4>
<p>Deputations are the process for a member of the public or a group to be able to speak or deliver a presentation to either a Committee or Council Meeting.</p>
<p>Anyone is able to request a deputation to a meeting.  For more information and details on how to request a deputation refer to the <a title="Deputation Request Form" href="https://www.rockhamptonregion.qld.gov.au/files/assets/public/legal-amp-governance/forms/gov02-deputation-request-form-v1.pdf" target="_blank">Deputation Request Form and Factsheet(PDF, 695KB)</a> .</p>
<p>For a full list of the guidelines to apply to present a deputation at a meeting please refer to the <a title="Deputation Guidelines" href="https://www.rockhamptonregion.qld.gov.au/files/assets/public/council-meetings/deputation-guidelines.pdf" target="_blank">Deputation Guidelines(PDF, 70KB)</a> .</p>

	$(document.getElementById('COVID_TEMP-messages').innerHTML).find('.item').each(function(){
		var $message = $(this);
		var isMatch = false;
		$message.find('.conditions a').each(function(){
			var $a = $(this);
			var mode = $a.text().split(' ')[0].toLowerCase();
			var value = $a.attr('href').replace(/^https?:\/\//g, '');

			switch(mode)
			{
				case 'startswith':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().startsWith(value.toLowerCase()))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'contains':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().indexOf(value.toLowerCase()) !== -1)
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'regex':
					var re = new RegExp(value);
					if(new RegExp(value).test(document.location.pathname))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				default:
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase() === value.toLowerCase())
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;
			}
		});
		if(isMatch)
		{
			var $main = $('#main-content');
			if($main.length === 0) return false;
			var $h1 = $main.find('h1').first();

			var title = $message.find('.title').text().trim();
			var type = $message.find('.type').text().trim();
			var description = $message.find('.description').html();
			var link = $message.find('.link').html();

			var $content = $('<section>').addClass('obj-venue');//class is a hack to inherit styling
			var $sideBox = $('<div>').addClass('side-box message-box message-type-'+type).appendTo($content);

			if(title !== '')
			{
				$('<h2>').addClass('side-box-title').text(title).appendTo($sideBox);
			}

			var descriptionBox = ''

			if(description.trim() !== '')
			{
				//If the description contains no html tags, wrap the text in p tags
				var noBrDesc = description.split('<br>').join('\r\n');
				if (!/<[^>]+>/.test(noBrDesc)) {
					description = '<p>' + noBrDesc.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n){2}((\r\n|\r|\n)+)?/g, '$2</p><p>') + '</p>';
					description = description.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n)/g, '<br>');
					description = description.replace('</p><p></p>', '</p>');
				}
				descriptionBox += description;
			}

			var hasLink = false;
			if(link.trim() !== '')
			{
				hasLink = true;
				descriptionBox += link;
			}

			var $descriptionBox = null;
			if(descriptionBox.trim() !== '')
			{
				$descriptionBox = $(descriptionBox);
				$('<div>').addClass('side-box-content').html(descriptionBox).appendTo($sideBox);
			}

			if($h1.length === 1)
			{
				$content.insertAfter($h1);
			}
			else
			{
				$content.appendTo($main);
			}

			if(hasLink)
			{
				var color = ($content.find('p').first() || $content.find('.side-box-content').first()).css('color');
				$content.find('a').css('color', color);
			}

			 return false;
		}

        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {

                clearGuard();

							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Meeting Agendas and Minutes</h1>

<h2>Council Meetings</h2>
<p>The Ordinary meetings of Council are set in accordance with Sections 257 of the <em>Local Government Regulation 2012</em> and are open for public attendance <em>(</em>some items may be closed to the public during the meeting to allow for discussion of confidential matters, this is known as 'Closed Session').</p>
<p>On some occasions matters may need to be considered before the next scheduled meeting of Ordinary Council.  In such cases a Special meeting will be called.</p>
<p>Rockhampton Regional Council Ordinary meetings will be held on the 2nd and 4th Tuesday of each month, commencing at 9:00am.</p>
<h2>Committee Meetings </h2>
<p>The Infrastructure Committee meeting commencing at 9:00am followed by Communities Committee meeting followed by Economic Development and Rockhampton Airport Committee meeting will be held on the 3rd Tuesday of each month.</p>
<p>Terms of Reference - <a title="Terms of Reference - Communities Committee" href="/files/assets/public/v/2/council-meetings/communities/terms-of-reference-communities-committee-13-august-2024.pdf" target="_blank" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Communities Committee<span class="file-info">(PDF, 89KB)</span></a></p>
<p>Terms of Reference - <a title="Terms of Reference - Infrastructure Committee" href="/files/assets/public/v/2/council-meetings/infrastructure/terms-of-reference-infrastructure-committee-13-august-2024.pdf" target="_blank" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Infrastructure Committee<span class="file-info">(PDF, 88KB)</span></a></p>
<p>Terms of Reference - <a href="/files/assets/public/v/2/council-meetings/council/2026-meetings/terms-of-reference-ed-and-airport-may-2026-1.pdf" target="_self" title="Terms of Reference - Economic Development and Rockhampton Airport Committee" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Economic Development and Rockhampton Airport Committee<span class="file-info">(PDF, 128KB)</span></a> </p>

<h4> </h4>
<h3>Previous Meeting Documents</h3>
<p>To see previous Council Meeting agenda and minute documents or defunct Committee Meeting agenda and minute documents <span style="font-size: 1em;">please</span> <a href="https://www.rockhamptonregion.qld.gov.au/AboutCouncil/Meetings-and-Minutes/Defunct-Committees" target="_blank" style="font-size: 1em;">click here</a> <span style="font-size: 1em;">and then select the relevant meeting. </span></p>
<h4>Council Meeting Procedures</h4>
<p>Rockhampton Regional Council adopted its Meeting Procedures at the Ordinary Council meeting on 11 June 2024.</p>
<p><a title="Council Meeting Procedures V3" href="https://www.rockhamptonregion.qld.gov.au/files/assets/public/legal-amp-governance/policies-amp-procedures/council-meeting-procedures-policy-v8-reviewed-17-april-2020.pdf" target="_none">Council Meeting Procedures(PDF, 234KB)</a> </p>
<h4>Petitions</h4>
<p>A petition may be tabled on behalf of constituents by either a Councillor or the Chief Executive Officer at the first available Ordinary meeting of Council. </p>
<p>For further information please refer to the Petition Submission Form and Petition Factsheet available here: <a title="Petition Template" href="https://www.rockhamptonregion.qld.gov.au/files/assets/public/legal-amp-governance/forms/gov01-petition-submission-form-v1.pdf" target="_blank">Petition Submission Form(PDF, 699KB)</a>.</p>
<h4>Deputations</h4>
<p>Deputations are the process for a member of the public or a group to be able to speak or deliver a presentation to either a Committee or Council Meeting.</p>
<p>Anyone is able to request a deputation to a meeting.  For more information and details on how to request a deputation refer to the <a title="Deputation Request Form" href="https://www.rockhamptonregion.qld.gov.au/files/assets/public/legal-amp-governance/forms/gov02-deputation-request-form-v1.pdf" target="_blank">Deputation Request Form and Factsheet(PDF, 695KB)</a> .</p>
<p>For a full list of the guidelines to apply to present a deputation at a meeting please refer to the <a title="Deputation Guidelines" href="https://www.rockhamptonregion.qld.gov.au/files/assets/public/council-meetings/deputation-guidelines.pdf" target="_blank">Deputation Guidelines(PDF, 70KB)</a> .</p>

<script id="COVID_TEMP-script">
	$(document.getElementById('COVID_TEMP-messages').innerHTML).find('.item').each(function(){
		var $message = $(this);
		var isMatch = false;
		$message.find('.conditions a').each(function(){
			var $a = $(this);
			var mode = $a.text().split(' ')[0].toLowerCase();
			var value = $a.attr('href').replace(/^https?:\/\//g, '');

			switch(mode)
			{
				case 'startswith':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().startsWith(value.toLowerCase()))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'contains':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().indexOf(value.toLowerCase()) !== -1)
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'regex':
					var re = new RegExp(value);
					if(new RegExp(value).test(document.location.pathname))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				default:
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase() === value.toLowerCase())
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;
			}
		});
		if(isMatch)
		{
			var $main = $('#main-content');
			if($main.length === 0) return false;
			var $h1 = $main.find('h1').first();

			var title = $message.find('.title').text().trim();
			var type = $message.find('.type').text().trim();
			var description = $message.find('.description').html();
			var link = $message.find('.link').html();

			var $content = $('<section>').addClass('obj-venue');//class is a hack to inherit styling
			var $sideBox = $('<div>').addClass('side-box message-box message-type-'+type).appendTo($content);

			if(title !== '')
			{
				$('<h2>').addClass('side-box-title').text(title).appendTo($sideBox);
			}

			var descriptionBox = ''

			if(description.trim() !== '')
			{
				//If the description contains no html tags, wrap the text in p tags
				var noBrDesc = description.split('<br>').join('\r\n');
				if (!/<[^>]+>/.test(noBrDesc)) {
					description = '<p>' + noBrDesc.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n){2}((\r\n|\r|\n)+)?/g, '$2</p><p>') + '</p>';
					description = description.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n)/g, '<br>');
					description = description.replace('</p><p></p>', '</p>');
				}
				descriptionBox += description;
			}

			var hasLink = false;
			if(link.trim() !== '')
			{
				hasLink = true;
				descriptionBox += link;
			}

			var $descriptionBox = null;
			if(descriptionBox.trim() !== '')
			{
				$descriptionBox = $(descriptionBox);
				$('<div>').addClass('side-box-content').html(descriptionBox).appendTo($sideBox);
			}

			if($h1.length === 1)
			{
				$content.insertAfter($h1);
			}
			else
			{
				$content.appendTo($main);
			}

			if(hasLink)
			{
				var color = ($content.find('p').first() || $content.find('.side-box-content').first()).css('color');
				$content.find('a').css('color', color);
			}

			 return false;
		}
	});

	})();

        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();

							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Meeting Agendas and Minutes</h1>

<h2>Council Meetings</h2>
<p>The Ordinary meetings of Council are set in accordance with Sections 257 of the <em>Local Government Regulation 2012</em> and are open for public attendance <em>(</em>some items may be closed to the public during the meeting to allow for discussion of confidential matters, this is known as 'Closed Session').</p>
<p>On some occasions matters may need to be considered before the next scheduled meeting of Ordinary Council.  In such cases a Special meeting will be called.</p>
<p>Rockhampton Regional Council Ordinary meetings will be held on the 2nd and 4th Tuesday of each month, commencing at 9:00am.</p>
<h2>Committee Meetings </h2>
<p>The Infrastructure Committee meeting commencing at 9:00am followed by Communities Committee meeting followed by Economic Development and Rockhampton Airport Committee meeting will be held on the 3rd Tuesday of each month.</p>
<p>Terms of Reference - <a title="Terms of Reference - Communities Committee" href="/files/assets/public/v/2/council-meetings/communities/terms-of-reference-communities-committee-13-august-2024.pdf" target="_blank" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Communities Committee<span class="file-info">(PDF, 89KB)</span></a></p>
<p>Terms of Reference - <a title="Terms of Reference - Infrastructure Committee" href="/files/assets/public/v/2/council-meetings/infrastructure/terms-of-reference-infrastructure-committee-13-august-2024.pdf" target="_blank" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Infrastructure Committee<span class="file-info">(PDF, 88KB)</span></a></p>
<p>Terms of Reference - <a href="/files/assets/public/v/2/council-meetings/council/2026-meetings/terms-of-reference-ed-and-airport-may-2026-1.pdf" target="_self" title="Terms of Reference - Economic Development and Rockhampton Airport Committee" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Economic Development and Rockhampton Airport Committee<span class="file-info">(PDF, 128KB)</span></a> </p>
<h2>Meeting Details</h2>
<p>Council and Committee meetings are livestreamed and may be <a href="https://www.youtube.com/user/RRCouncil/videos?view=2&flow=grid">viewed online</a><em style="font-size: 1em;">.</em></p>
<p>View 2026 Rockhampton Regional Council <a title="Meeting Schedule 2025 v2" href="/files/assets/public/v/23/council-meetings/schedule-of-meetings/meeting-schedule-2026-for-website-230926.pdf" target="_self" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>schedule of meetings<span class="file-info">(PDF, 220KB)</span></a>. </p>
<p>Meetings are generally held in the Council Chambers at City Hall, 232 Bolsover Street, Rockhampton, however occasionally meetings may be required to be held in other locations.</p>

<h4> </h4>
<h3>Previous Meeting Documents</h3>
<p>To see previous Council Meeting agenda and minute documents or defunct Committee Meeting agenda and minute documents <span style="font-size: 1em;">please</span> <a href="https://www.rockhamptonregion.qld.gov.au/AboutCouncil/Meetings-and-Minutes/Defunct-Committees" target="_blank" style="font-size: 1em;">click here</a> <span style="font-size: 1em;">and then select the relevant meeting. </span></p>
<h4>Council Meeting Procedures</h4>
<p>Rockhampton Regional Council adopted its Meeting Procedures at the Ordinary Council meeting on 11 June 2024.</p>
<p><a title="Council Meeting Procedures V3" href="https://www.rockhamptonregion.qld.gov.au/files/assets/public/legal-amp-governance/policies-amp-procedures/council-meeting-procedures-policy-v8-reviewed-17-april-2020.pdf" target="_none">Council Meeting Procedures(PDF, 234KB)</a> </p>
<h4>Petitions</h4>
<p>A petition may be tabled on behalf of constituents by either a Councillor or the Chief Executive Officer at the first available Ordinary meeting of Council. </p>
<p>For further information please refer to the Petition Submission Form and Petition Factsheet available here: <a title="Petition Template" href="https://www.rockhamptonregion.qld.gov.au/files/assets/public/legal-amp-governance/forms/gov01-petition-submission-form-v1.pdf" target="_blank">Petition Submission Form(PDF, 699KB)</a>.</p>
<h4>Deputations</h4>
<p>Deputations are the process for a member of the public or a group to be able to speak or deliver a presentation to either a Committee or Council Meeting.</p>
<p>Anyone is able to request a deputation to a meeting.  For more information and details on how to request a deputation refer to the <a title="Deputation Request Form" href="https://www.rockhamptonregion.qld.gov.au/files/assets/public/legal-amp-governance/forms/gov02-deputation-request-form-v1.pdf" target="_blank">Deputation Request Form and Factsheet(PDF, 695KB)</a> .</p>
<p>For a full list of the guidelines to apply to present a deputation at a meeting please refer to the <a title="Deputation Guidelines" href="https://www.rockhamptonregion.qld.gov.au/files/assets/public/council-meetings/deputation-guidelines.pdf" target="_blank">Deputation Guidelines(PDF, 70KB)</a> .</p>

		var $message = $(this);
		var isMatch = false;
		$message.find('.conditions a').each(function(){
			var $a = $(this);
			var mode = $a.text().split(' ')[0].toLowerCase();
			var value = $a.attr('href').replace(/^https?:\/\//g, '');

			switch(mode)
			{
				case 'startswith':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().startsWith(value.toLowerCase()))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'contains':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().indexOf(value.toLowerCase()) !== -1)
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'regex':
					var re = new RegExp(value);
					if(new RegExp(value).test(document.location.pathname))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				default:
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase() === value.toLowerCase())
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;
			}
		});
		if(isMatch)
		{
			var $main = $('#main-content');
			if($main.length === 0) return false;
			var $h1 = $main.find('h1').first();

			var title = $message.find('.title').text().trim();

			var description = $message.find('.description').html();
			var link = $message.find('.link').html();

			if(title !== '')
			{
				$('<h2>').addClass('side-box-title').text(title).appendTo($sideBox);
			}

			var descriptionBox = ''

			if(description.trim() !== '')
			{
				//If the description contains no html tags, wrap the text in p tags
				var noBrDesc = description.split('<br>').join('\r\n');
				if (!/<[^>]+>/.test(noBrDesc)) {
					description = '<p>' + noBrDesc.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n){2}((\r\n|\r|\n)+)?/g, '$2</p><p>') + '</p>';
					description = description.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n)/g, '<br>');
					description = description.replace('</p><p></p>', '</p>');

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
